verdicts.reason: Both break the same way. The colourful geometric background is cut down to a thin, mostly covered strip. A blank white box with two stray pink dots sits uselessly on the right. The opening-date line butts right up against the 'THE MINIMALIST' pill, and 'DDG STUDIO PRESENTS' floats on its own with no frame or grouping. B keeps slightly more of the pink and blue pattern visible around the name block, so a little more of the brand survives, but its pill and date line almost touch. A's name block covers nearly all the pattern.
